title: IN WHICH PHILEAS FOGG SIMPLY DOES HIS DUTY
summary_hover: Fogg sacrifices his schedule to rescue Passepartout from the Sioux, missing his train but successfully returning with his servant.
summary_detail: Discovering Passepartout missing after the Sioux attack, Fogg hires thirty soldiers from Fort Kearney to rescue him, knowing the delay will likely cost him his wager. While he is gone, the runaway locomotive returns, and the train departs for Omaha without Fogg, Aouda, or Fix. Fogg returns the next morning, having successfully rescued Passepartout, only to find the train gone.
